answer: What survives to the umber is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, held in escrow until finality, idle agents bleed standing. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The forge is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the ferrous.
